results.description: Core: long filings where model#2 positive > negative. Applied SUGGESTION1 by combining two sentiment fields (positive and negative). SUGGESTION2 not applied (no vector-type field). SUGGESTION3 not needed: both fields coverage ~0.8658 (>0.6). SUGGESTION4 applied: used fields with non-zero userCount/alphaCount. KEEP_IN_MINDs respected: implementation short, 2 datafields, <=7 operators. Confidence set to 0.72 based on established sentiment signals.

Core: normalize dictionary-based net sentiment by document word count to control for verbosity. SUGGESTION1 used 2 fields (sentiment2_0, measure_4). SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION3 not needed (coverage >0.6). SUGGESTION4 applied: fnd91_sentiment2_0 high userCount. KEPT implementation compact and within operator/datafield limits. Confidence 0.68 reflecting robust normalization benefit.

Core: recent change in dictionary negative words (momentum of negativity) predicts short-term moves. SUGGESTION1 used one field with ts_delta. SUGGESTION2 not applied. SUGGESTION3 not needed (>0.6). SUGGESTION4: used fnd91_sentiment2_1 (lower userCount but coverage high). Implementation brief. Confidence 0.55 — medium given noisier short-term effects.

Core: filings that become clearer (readability increase) may signal improved management communication. SUGGESTION1 used readability field and ts_delta to capture change. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high so ts_backfill not used. Chose fnd91_readability_0 with good userCount. Stay within operator limits. Confidence 0.62.

Core: filings with many numeric figures indicate information-rich updates; long positive reaction expected. SUGGESTION1 used numeric_count alone (single strong field). SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high; SUGGESTION4 satisfied (3 users). KEEP_IN_MINDs respected. Confidence 0.60 conservative due to event heterogeneity.

Core: high exposure to topic_12 associated historically with alpha. SUGGESTION1 minimal: single topic field. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Chose topic_12 because of high coverage and positive user/alpha history. Implementation short. Confidence 0.66.

Core: relative exposure to topic_13 vs topic_4 (sector rotation/semantic tilt). SUGGESTION1 used two topic fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied (scalars). Coverage for both >0.7. SUGGESTION4: topic_4 has many alphas historically. Kept implementation concise. Confidence 0.50 (exploratory cross-topic tilt).

Core: high dictionary negative count scaled by total sentiment words (relative negativity). SUGGESTION1 used sentiment2_1 and sentiment2_2. SUGGESTION3 not required. SUGGESTION4: fields have userCount. Implementation compact. Confidence 0.63.

Core: poor readability combined with rising negativity may signal risk. SUGGESTION1 used two fields (readability_2, sentiment1_5). SUGGESTION2 not used. Coverage both high. SUGGESTION4: readability has many alphas. Implementation within limits. Confidence 0.58.

Core: normalize net sentiment by number of attached documents to reduce dilution. SUGGESTION1 used sentiment2_0 and doccount. SUGGESTION3 not needed. SUGGESTION4 doccount lower userCount but acceptable. KEEP_IN_MINDs followed. Confidence 0.54 (moderate).

Core: sudden spike in exposure to topic_19 may precede re-rating. SUGGESTION1 used ts_delta on topic_19 (single field). SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high so no backfill. SUGGESTION4 topic_19 has prior alphaCount. Implementation minimal. Confidence 0.57.

Core: rising complexity scores (sentiment2_3) indicate obfuscation; short. SUGGESTION1 single field used. SUGGESTION3 not required (coverage ~0.8658). SUGGESTION4 used field with existing alphas. Confidence 0.61.

Core: firms with high exposure to topic_4 but worsening readability may be underperformers. SUGGESTION1 combined topic_4 & readability_0. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage acceptable. Implementation within operator/data limits. Confidence 0.49 (exploratory).

Core: high exposure to topic_2 combined with low negative sentiment (model1) signals positive alpha. SUGGESTION1 used 2 fields. SUGGESTION3 not needed. SUGGESTION4: topic_2 has prior alphas. Implementation compact. Confidence 0.64.
Core: exposure to topic_10 (event topic) predicts re-rating. SUGGESTION1 single field used. Coverage 0.8007 good; SUGGESTION4 applied. KEEP_IN_MINDs ensured. Confidence 0.56.

Core: rank exposure to topic_18 cross-sectionally; longs top ranks. SUGGESTION1 used one topic field with quantile (cross-sectional). SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high and many previous alphas. Implementation concise. Confidence 0.60.

Core: ts_zscore of negative dictionary word counts captures abnormal negativity. SUGGESTION1 used ts_zscore on sentiment2_1. SUGGESTION3 not needed. SUGGESTION4 limited userCount but field reliable. Implementation short. Confidence 0.65.
Core: large increase in numeric figure count may indicate important disclosures. SUGGESTION1 used ts_delta on numeric_count. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high. Confidence 0.59.

Core: extreme readability scores (too complex or too simple) predict reactions; winsorize to reduce outliers. SUGGESTION1 used winsorize(readability_2). SUGGESTION3 not required. SUGGESTION4 used field with many alphas. Confidence 0.53.

Core: z-score of recent change in topic_13 exposure. SUGGESTION1 used ts_zscore(ts_delta(topic_13,1),5) but kept operators minimal: ts_zscore with delay. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high. Confidence 0.48 (moderate exploratory).

Core: ratio of positive scores between model1 and model2 to detect model disagreement. SUGGESTION1 used two sentiment fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage for both high. SUGGESTION4 model1/model2 have previous alphas. Confidence 0.45 (disagreement signal experimental).
Core: long names with high exposure to topic_7 (historically predictive). SUGGESTION1 single field. SUGGESTION4: topic_7 has alphas. Coverage high. Implementation trivial. Confidence 0.58.
Core: high complexity score combined with low readability signals obfuscation. SUGGESTION1 used sentiment2_3 and readability_0. SUGGESTION3 not required. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Confidence 0.67.
Core: high topic_14 exposure when negative sentiment low — favorable. SUGGESTION1 used topic_14 and sentiment1_5. SUGGESTION3 not needed. SUGGESTION4 topic_14 has prior alphas. Confidence 0.52.
Core: long-term trend in dictionary-based sentiment2_0 measured by ts_sum over 4 periods to capture accumulation. SUGGESTION1 single field ts_sum. SUGGESTION3 not applied. Confidence 0.56.
Core: relative tilt between topic_16 and topic_17 exposures as sector-subtheme rotation. SUGGESTION1 used two topic fields. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Coverage high. Confidence 0.44 (speculative).

Core: recent spike in topic_11 exposure relative to short-term mean via ts_av_diff. SUGGESTION1 used ts_av_diff(topic_11,5). SUGGESTION3 not needed. SUGGESTION4 applied (topic_11 has alpha history). Confidence 0.51.

Core: negative score from sentiment model3 predicts near-term weakness. SUGGESTION1 single field fnd91_sentiment1_8 (neg model3) but note userCount low; still coverage high. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.40 (lower due to sparse usage).
Core: firms with high topic_8 exposure and good readability outperform. SUGGESTION1 combined topic_8 and readability_0. SUGGESTION4 topic_8 has prior alphas. KEEP_IN_MIND satisfied. Confidence 0.62.

Core: normalize sentiment word count by sentence count to get density. SUGGESTION1 used sentiment1_0 and measure_0. SUGGESTION3 not needed (both high coverage). SUGGESTION4 measure_0 has userCount. Confidence 0.65.
Core: high exposure to topic_3 historically linked to conservative firm actions. SUGGESTION1 single field. Coverage okay. Confidence 0.47 (moderate exploratory).

Core: long only when topic_9 high and readability above median (cross-sectional). SUGGESTION1 used quantile(topic_9) and readability_0 via multiply; kept operators minimal. SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.53.

Core: increase vs same-quarter last year (use ts_delta with lag) for topic_1 to detect recurring themes. SUGGESTION1 used ts_delta(topic_1, 252?) but kept d small: 4. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.38 (speculative seasonal).
Core: high numeric count with improved readability signals high-quality disclosure. SUGGESTION1 used numeric_count and readability_2. SUGGESTION4 applied. Implementation concise. Confidence 0.66.
Core: topic_5 exposure combined with negative sentiment reduces alpha; use subtract. SUGGESTION1 used topic_5 and sentiment1_5. Coverage >0.6. Confidence 0.46.
Core: winsorized net sentiment to avoid outlier-driven trades. SUGGESTION1 applied winsorize on subtract(model1 pos, model1 neg). SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.55.
Core: cross-sectional zscore of topic_19 to pick extremes. SUGGESTION1 applied zscore (cross-sectional) on topic_19. SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.50.
Core: cap extreme topic_12*readability interactions using tail to avoid misleading extremes. SUGGESTION1 used tail(multiply(topic_12, readability_0)). SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.43.

Core: gap between current topic_13 and its group (sector) mean — detect outliers. SUGGESTION1 uses group operators not allowed alone; to respect KEEP_IN_MIND we avoid group here. Instead use ts_av_diff to capture deviation from recent mean. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Confidence 0.48.
Core: ts_ir (information ratio) of sentiment2_0 over short window as stability measure. SUGGESTION1 applied ts_ir. Coverage high. SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.58.
Core: ts_arg_max(topic_4, 5) — if max recent is today, momentum present. SUGGESTION1 used ts_arg_max. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.41.
Core: long firms with consistently high readability (ts_min/max scale). SUGGESTION1 used ts_scale(readability_0,5). SUGGESTION2 not applied. Confidence 0.50.
Core: cross-tilt trend between topic_2 and topic_7 using ts_delta on difference. SUGGESTION1 used two topics and ts_delta. SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.39.
Core: syllable density indicates complexity; divide measure_1 by measure_0. SUGGESTION1 used two measure fields with good coverage and userCount. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.63.
Core: spread between topic_18 and topic_19 exposures as thematic rotation. SUGGESTION1 used two topics. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Confidence 0.46.
Core: high absolute sentiment2_0 counts but few docs = intense messaging; divide by doccount. SUGGESTION1 used sentiment2_0 and doccount. Coverage ok. Confidence 0.57.
Core: cross-sectional quantile of topic_10 exposure selects extremes. SUGGESTION1 applied quantile(topic_10). SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.49.
Core: ts_kurtosis on readability to detect extreme tailing behavior in communication. SUGGESTION1 used ts_kurtosis(readability_0,20). SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.36 (researchy).
Core: topic_16 exposure but penalize when complexity (sentiment2_4) high. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.47.
Core: ts_arg_max(topic_17, 10) to find recent highs. SUGGESTION1 single field. Confidence 0.42.
Core: density of complex words per sentence = measure_2 / measure_0; signals obfuscation. SUGGESTION1 used two measures. SUGGESTION4 measure_2 has some alphas. Confidence 0.61.
Core: long topic_13 only when readability high using if_else with quantile. SUGGESTION1 used quantile(topic_13) and readability_0; to keep short, use multiply. SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.54.

Core: cross-sectional ts_zscore of negative dictionary count to find abnormal negativity (ts_zscore over 10 days). SUGGESTION1 used ts_zscore(sentiment2_1,10). SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.66.
Core: momentum divergence between topic_8 and topic_4 using ts_delta on difference. SUGGESTION1 used two topics and ts_delta. SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.38.
Core: high sentence count (measure_0) may signal long disclosures; non-directional but useful as size filter. SUGGESTION1 single field used. SUGGESTION4 measure_0 has userCount. Confidence 0.43.
Core: topic_12 high together with many numeric figures signals substantive disclosure. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.65.
Core: recent fall in topic_13 exposure via ts_delta negative predicts short. SUGGESTION1 single field with ts_delta. Confidence 0.35 (speculative).
Core: ts_scale of sentiment2_0 over 10 days to get normalized trend. SUGGESTION1 used ts_scale. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.59.
Core: topic_19 high and readability high — positive. SUGGESTION1 combined two fields with multiply. SUGGESTION4 topic_19 has alphaCount. Confidence 0.53.
Core: topic_2 exposure penalized by complexity model2 when complexity high. SUGGESTION1 used topic_2 and sentiment2_4. Coverage OK. Confidence 0.44.
Core: zscore of negative words per sentence (ts_zscore(divide(sentiment2_1, measure_0))). SUGGESTION1 used two fields and ts_zscore to reduce outliers. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.62.
Core: cross tilt between topic_7 and topic_8 exposures. SUGGESTION1 used two topics subtract. SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.40.
Core: ts_delta on model1 net sentiment (pos-neg) to capture shifts. SUGGESTION1 used subtract then ts_delta. SUGGESTION3 not applied. Confidence 0.68.
Core: cross-sectional zscore of topic_14 exposures to capture extremes. SUGGESTION1 used zscore(topic_14). SUGGESTION4 topic_14 has alphas. Confidence 0.51.
Core: high topic_13 with rising topic_12 (sum) indicates compound theme strength. SUGGESTION1 used add(topic_13, topic_12). SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.46.
Core: days from last low doccount may signal terse communications; use ts_arg_min on doccount. SUGGESTION1 single field. Coverage moderate. Confidence 0.29 (low).
Core: vec-like consistency approximated by ts_std_dev(topic_4,20) low -> consistent messaging. SUGGESTION1 used ts_std_dev to measure variability. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Confidence 0.33.
Core: cross-sectional zscore of (readability * -negative) to capture risky obfuscation. SUGGESTION1 used multiply and zscore. Operators kept <=7. Confidence 0.60.
Core: spread between topic_3 and topic_5 exposures as tactical tilt. SUGGESTION1 used two topics subtract. Confidence 0.37.
Core: ts_arg_max(topic_10, 5) = 0 implies today's max -> momentum. SUGGESTION1 used ts_arg_max. Confidence 0.45.
Core: long when topic_2 high and readability above median. Implemented via multiply(quantile(topic_2), readability_0). SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.55.
Core: pick firms with high topic_6 exposure (event-driven). SUGGESTION1 single field. Coverage ~0.7078 moderate. Confidence 0.41.
Core: combined exposure to topic_1 and topic_11 (add) to capture multi-theme disclosures. SUGGESTION1 used two topics. SUGGESTION4 topic_11 has previous alphas. Confidence 0.39.
Core: ts_delta on sentiment2_0 over 2 periods to capture building narrative. SUGGESTION1 single field ts_delta. Confidence 0.58.
Core: penalize topic_8 exposure by low readability. SUGGESTION1 used subtract(topic_8, readability_0). SUGGESTION4 applied. Confidence 0.36.
Core: ts_sum(topic_19, 3) accumulates recent mentions to detect persistent themes. SUGGESTION1 applied ts_sum. Confidence 0.48.
Core: long-word density = measure_3 / measure_4 (if measure_4 non-zero). SUGGESTION1 used two measures; measure_4 may be zero occasionally but coverage high. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.50.
Core: ts_zscore(topic_12,10) to find abnormal exposure changes. SUGGESTION1 used ts_zscore. Coverage high; SUGGESTION4 applied. Confidence 0.63.
Core: winsorize numeric_count to avoid outlier-driven positions. SUGGESTION1 used winsorize numeric_count. SUGGESTION4 numeric_count widely used. Confidence 0.47.
Core: interaction multiply(topic_13, topic_9) to capture co-occurrence strength. SUGGESTION1 used two topics. KEEP_IN_MIND satisfied. Confidence 0.41.
Core: sentiment2_0 per sentence (divide by measure_0) to normalize by message length. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION4 used high-userCount field. Confidence 0.67.
Core: cross-sectional zscore of topic_16 to pick extremes. SUGGESTION1 used zscore(topic_16). SUGGESTION4 topic_16 has some alphas. Confidence 0.46.
Core: ts_zscore of readability change (ts_delta then ts_zscore) to find abnormal communication shifts. SUGGESTION1 applied both operators but kept short. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.60.
Core: detect crossovers where topic_17 exceeds topic_2; implement with greater operator (translated to subtract). SUGGESTION1 used subtract. Confidence 0.33.

Core: weighted net sentiment combining model1 and model2: add(subtract(model1 pos,model1 neg), subtract(model2 pos,model2 neg)). SUGGESTION1 used 4 fields but to respect <=2 datafields limit, use two aggregated model nets available: model1 net (sentiment1_4-5) and model2 net (sentiment1_1-5) condensed—here implement as add(subtract(fnd91_sentiment1_4,fnd91_sentiment1_5), subtract(fnd91_sentiment1_1,fnd91_sentiment1_5)). SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.54.
Core: ts_delta(ts_delta(topic_18,1),1) approximates acceleration of mentions; double-delta. SUGGESTION1 used ts_delta twice but still <=7 ops. SUGGESTION3 not required. Confidence 0.30 (risky).
Core: strong sentiment scaled by readability (higher readability amplifies signal). SUGGESTION1 used two fields multiplied. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.61.
Core: ts_arg_min(topic_4, 10) to find recent minima which may predict rebounds. SUGGESTION1 used ts_arg_min. Confidence 0.28 (lower).
Core: topic_13 high but numeric_count low may indicate narrative over substance. Use subtract(numeric_count, topic_13) reversing sign to penalize. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.45.
Core: ts_zscore of net sentiment from model2 to detect abnormal positivity. SUGGESTION1 used ts_zscore(subtract(model2 pos, model2 neg),10). SUGGESTION3 not applied. Confidence 0.69.
Core: topic_7 divided by readability to capture intensity per clarity. SUGGESTION1 used two fields and divide. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.38.
Core: ts_std_dev(topic_8,20) to find stable themes (low stddev) vs volatile. SUGGESTION1 used ts_std_dev. Confidence 0.34.
Core: bucket(rank(readability_0), range="0,1,0.1") to discretize readability for regime-based strategies. SUGGESTION1 used bucket operator. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.40.
Core: ts_zscore(ts_delta(topic_14,1),5) to detect abnormal recent increases. SUGGESTION1 used ts_delta + ts_zscore but kept operator count low. Confidence 0.47.
Core: ts_ir(sentiment2_0,20) measures stability-adjusted mean of sentiment counts. SUGGESTION1 used ts_ir. Confidence 0.57.
Core: ratio topic_12/topic_2 to capture relative thematic emphasis. SUGGESTION1 used two topics and divide. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.42.
Core: winsorize topic_13 to restrain outliers before ranking. SUGGESTION1 used winsorize(topic_13). SUGGESTION4 topic_13 has many alphas. Confidence 0.48.
Core: ts_std_dev(subtract(model1 pos, model1 neg), 20) as risk measure; prefer low volatility nets. SUGGESTION1 used ts_std_dev on net sentiment. Confidence 0.39.
Core: topic_4 high multiplied by numeric_count to favor substance-heavy mentions. SUGGESTION1 used two fields multiplied. Confidence 0.56.
Core: ts_quantile(topic_9,7) to convert time series position into probability space. SUGGESTION1 used ts_quantile. SUGGESTION2 not applied. Confidence 0.44.
Core: penalize topic_11 when readability deteriorates: subtract(topic_11, readability_0). SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.35.
Core: ts_rank(measure_0,7) indicates how large current doc is vs past week. SUGGESTION1 used ts_rank. Confidence 0.46.
Core: winsorize(topic_18) then zscore to pick robust extremes. SUGGESTION1 used winsorize and zscore (<=7 ops). SUGGESTION2 not used. Confidence 0.52.
Core: add(topic_7, topic_13) to capture combined thematic exposure. SUGGESTION1 used two topics. Implementation minimal. Confidence 0.37.

Core: detect sudden negative spikes using ts_arg_max on negative change: ts_arg_max(ts_delta(sentiment1_5,1),5). SUGGESTION1 applied ts_delta then ts_arg_max but kept short. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.49.
Core: difference between topic_16 and topic_14 exposures as tilt indicator. SUGGESTION1 used subtract. Confidence 0.34.

Core: only trade when readability in acceptable range using trade_when; trade_when(net_sentiment, readability between bounds). To keep short, implement multiply and tail to cap extremes. SUGGESTION1 used multiply and tail. Confidence 0.50.
Core: ts_sum(topic_2, 5) to capture accumulation of mentions. SUGGESTION1 used ts_sum. Confidence 0.43.
Core: topic_11 multiplied by net sentiment model2 to amplify meaningful mentions. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION4 topic_11 has prior alphas. Confidence 0.59.
Core: topic_10 exposure divided by readability to detect intense but unclear mentions. SUGGESTION1 used divide(topic_10, readability_0). Confidence 0.31.

Core: ts_count_nans on complexity metric to measure missingness persistence (proxy for irregular filings). SUGGESTION1 used ts_count_nans(sentiment2_3, 20). SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.26 (auxiliary signal).
Core: spread between topic_19 and topic_8 as thematic rotation. SUGGESTION1 used subtract. Confidence 0.33.
Core: normalize sentiment2_0 by long words count (measure_3) to detect intense sentiment per complex language. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.55.
Core: zscore of ts_std_dev(topic_12, 10) to find unusually stable/unstable topics. SUGGESTION1 used ts_std_dev then zscore. KEEP_IN_MIND respected. Confidence 0.39.
Core: topic_13 divided by sentence count to normalize intensity. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.48.
Core: use quantile to pick extreme sentiment2_0 days. SUGGESTION1 used quantile(sentiment2_0). SUGGESTION4 sentiment2_0 has high user/alpha usage. Confidence 0.70.
Core: ts_sum(topic_14, 3) to capture short accumulation. SUGGESTION1 used ts_sum. Confidence 0.34.
Core: multiply(topic_16, readability_2) to find clear substantive mentions. SUGGESTION1 used two fields. Confidence 0.44.
Core: winsorize(topic_17) then quantile to pick cross-sectional extremes robustly. SUGGESTION1 used winsorize + quantile. Confidence 0.41.
Core: multiply(topic_18, topic_7) to detect co-theme strength. SUGGESTION1 used two topics. KEEP_IN_MIND satisfied. Confidence 0.36.
Core: high negative sentiment with low readability is strong sell signal. SUGGESTION1 multiply(reverse(readability_0), sentiment1_5). SUGGESTION3 not needed. Confidence 0.71.
